description: This file defines the DonAsynchron utility class providing asynchronous programming helpers using Guava and Java concurrency constructs.

classes.name: DonAsynchron
classes.description: Utility class providing methods for asynchronous execution and callback handling.

methods.name: withCallback
methods.description: Attaches success and failure callbacks to a ListenableFuture, optionally using a specified executor.

methods.name: submit
methods.description: Submits a Callable task for execution with success and failure callbacks, returning a ListenableFuture.

methods.name: toFluentFuture
methods.description: Converts a CompletableFuture into a Guava FluentFuture.
